title.en: Lost TennCare in Tennessee? Your 90-Day SEP Guide 2026
title.es: Perdio TennCare en Tennessee? Guia SEP 90 Dias 2026

description.en: Lost TennCare in 2026? You have 90 days to enroll in ACA marketplace coverage. Tennessee does not expand Medicaid, so options and next steps are different here.
description.es: Perdio TennCare en 2026? Tiene 90 dias para inscribirse en cobertura ACA. Tennessee no expande Medicaid, por lo que sus opciones son diferentes aqui.

h1.en: Lost TennCare in Tennessee? Here Are Your Next Steps for 2026
h1.es: Perdio TennCare en Tennessee? Aqui Estan Sus Proximos Pasos para 2026

subhero.en: You have 90 days from your TennCare termination date to enroll in an ACA Marketplace plan. Tennessee is a non-expansion state, so re-qualifying for TennCare has strict income limits that affect your options.
subhero.es: Tiene 90 dias desde la fecha de terminacion de TennCare para inscribirse en un plan del Mercado ACA. Tennessee no expande Medicaid, por lo que re-calificar para TennCare tiene limites de ingresos estrictos.

heading.en: You have 90 days from your TennCare termination date
heading.es: Tiene 90 dias desde la fecha de terminacion de su TennCare

body.en: Your 90-day Marketplace SEP runs from your TennCare coverage end date through 90 days later. For example, if TennCare ends June 1, 2026, your SEP window closes August 30, 2026. Miss that deadline and you must wait until the ACA Open Enrollment Period starting November 1, 2026 for 2027 coverage, unless another qualifying life event occurs.
body.es: Su SEP del Mercado de 90 dias corre desde la fecha de fin de cobertura de TennCare hasta 90 dias despues. Por ejemplo, si TennCare termina el 1 de junio de 2026, su ventana SEP cierra el 30 de agosto de 2026. Si pierde esa fecha limite, debe esperar hasta la Inscripcion Abierta del ACA a partir del 1 de noviembre de 2026 para cobertura 2027.

label.en: TennCare re-enrollment if income drops back to qualifying levels
label.es: Reinscripcion TennCare si el ingreso baja a niveles calificadores

quickAnswer.en: Losing TennCare in Tennessee gives you a 90-day Special Enrollment Period to enroll in an ACA Marketplace plan at healthcare.gov, which is longer than the standard 60-day SEP for other coverage losses. Tennessee does not expand Medicaid under the ACA, so most adults cannot simply re-apply for TennCare unless they are parents under roughly 100% FPL ($21,640 for a household of two), pregnant women under 250% FPL, or disabled. Your three main 2026 options are: (1) ACA Marketplace plan with premium tax credits if your income is between 100% and 400% FPL, (2) TennCare re-enrollment if your income still qualifies under Tennessee's strict limits, or (3) TennCare Kids for any children in your household. File your appeal AND apply for marketplace coverage at the same time.
quickAnswer.es: Perder TennCare en Tennessee le da un Periodo de Inscripcion Especial de 90 dias para inscribirse en un plan del Mercado ACA en healthcare.gov, que es mas largo que el SEP estandar de 60 dias para otras perdidas de cobertura. Tennessee no expande Medicaid bajo el ACA, por lo que la mayoria de los adultos no pueden simplemente volver a solicitar TennCare a menos que sean padres con ingresos bajo el 100% FPL aproximadamente ($21,640 para un hogar de dos), mujeres embarazadas bajo el 250% FPL, o personas discapacitadas. Sus tres opciones principales en 2026 son: (1) plan del Mercado ACA con creditos fiscales si su ingreso esta entre el 100% y el 400% FPL, (2) reinscripcion en TennCare si su ingreso aun califica, o (3) TennCare Kids para los ninos de su hogar. Presente su apelacion Y solicite cobertura del Mercado simultaneamente.

introParagraphs.en: TennCare, Tennessee's Medicaid program, covers roughly 1.4 million Tennesseans including children, pregnant women, disabled adults, and low-income parents. Losing TennCare in 2026 is a particularly stressful event because Tennessee is one of the 10 states that has not expanded Medicaid under the ACA, which means most adults below 100% FPL who lose TennCare fall into a coverage gap. The ACA Marketplace is designed for people earning between 100% and 400% FPL in 2026, which is roughly $15,960 to $63,840 per year for a single adult. Adults under 100% FPL in Tennessee who do not qualify for TennCare and cannot afford Marketplace coverage face a serious coverage gap that advocates have lobbied the state to address since 2014. Understanding exactly where your income falls against the 2026 FPL thresholds is the first step after losing TennCare, because it determines whether you go to the Marketplace, back to TennCare, or need to pursue one of the safety-net options described in this guide.
introParagraphs.es: TennCare, el programa Medicaid de Tennessee, cubre aproximadamente 1.4 millones de residentes de Tennessee, incluyendo ninos, mujeres embarazadas, adultos discapacitados y padres de bajos ingresos. Perder TennCare en 2026 es un evento particularmente estresante porque Tennessee es uno de los 10 estados que no ha expandido Medicaid bajo el ACA, lo que significa que la mayoria de los adultos por debajo del 100% FPL que pierden TennCare caen en una brecha de cobertura. El Mercado ACA esta disenado para personas que ganan entre el 100% y el 400% FPL en 2026, que es aproximadamente entre $15,960 y $63,840 al ano para un adulto soltero. Entender exactamente donde cae su ingreso frente a los umbrales FPL de 2026 es el primer paso despues de perder TennCare.

introParagraphs.en: Six concrete steps follow in this guide: how to use your 90-day qualifying life event SEP window, appeal a TennCare termination, and choose between the Marketplace and re-enrollment. Tennessee's TennCare program uses stricter income limits than Medicaid expansion states: parents qualify up to approximately 100% of the Federal Poverty Level, pregnant women up to 250% FPL, and TennCare Kids covers children under 19 with age-tiered income limits. The One Big Beautiful Bill Act signed July 4, 2025 introduced new work requirements and stricter redetermination schedules affecting TennCare enrollees in 2026. A TennCare termination based on a paperwork error or disputed income can be appealed while you simultaneously apply for Marketplace coverage at healthcare.gov to prevent a coverage gap. The ACA Marketplace Open Enrollment Period for 2027 coverage begins November 1, 2026, so the 90-day SEP is the only enrollment window available to most Tennesseans who lose TennCare mid-year.
introParagraphs.es: Esta guia cubre los 6 pasos a seguir inmediatamente despues de perder TennCare en Tennessee, como usar su ventana SEP de evento calificador de vida de 90 dias, y los umbrales de ingresos especificos que importan para 2026. El programa TennCare de Tennessee usa limites de ingresos mas estrictos que los estados con expansion de Medicaid: los padres califican hasta aproximadamente el 100% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza, las mujeres embarazadas hasta el 250% FPL, y TennCare Kids cubre a los ninos menores de 19 anos con limites de ingresos por edad. Si su terminacion de TennCare se baso en un error de papeleo o un ingreso en disputa, puede apelar la decision mientras solicita simultaneamente cobertura del Mercado en healthcare.gov para evitar una brecha.

name.en: Read your TennCare termination notice immediately
name.es: Lea su aviso de terminacion de TennCare de inmediato

text.en: TennCare must send written notice before ending your coverage. Check the notice for the exact termination date, the stated reason (income redetermination, work requirements, paperwork, or age-out), and the appeal deadline. Tennessee allows 30 days from the notice date to request a TennCare fair hearing. If you filed required documents on time and coverage was still cut, that may be a procedural error you can appeal. Call TennCare Member Services at 1-800-342-3145 or visit your local Department of Human Services office.
text.es: TennCare debe enviar un aviso escrito antes de terminar su cobertura. Verifique la fecha exacta de terminacion, la razon indicada y la fecha limite de apelacion. Tennessee permite 30 dias desde la fecha del aviso para solicitar una audiencia justa de TennCare. Llame a los Servicios para Miembros de TennCare al 1-800-342-3145 o visite su oficina local del Departamento de Servicios Humanos.

name.en: Check whether you can re-qualify for TennCare under Tennessee's income limits
name.es: Verifique si puede recalificar para TennCare bajo los limites de ingreso de Tennessee

text.en: Tennessee did not expand Medicaid, so TennCare income limits are much stricter than the 138% FPL threshold in expansion states. For 2026, eligible groups include: parents with dependent children at or below 100% FPL (approximately $21,640 for a household of two), pregnant women up to 250% FPL (approximately $54,100 for a household of two), children under 19 through TennCare Kids (income limits vary by age), and SSI recipients and disabled adults meeting federal criteria. If your income or household changed, re-apply at tenncare.tn.gov or through your local Department of Human Services office year-round.
text.es: Tennessee no expandio Medicaid, por lo que los limites de ingreso de TennCare son mucho mas estrictos que el umbral del 138% FPL en los estados con expansion. Para 2026, los grupos elegibles incluyen: padres con hijos dependientes hasta el 100% FPL (aproximadamente $21,640 para un hogar de dos), mujeres embarazadas hasta el 250% FPL (aproximadamente $54,100 para un hogar de dos), ninos menores de 19 anos a traves de TennCare Kids (los limites de ingresos varian por edad), y recipientes de SSI y adultos discapacitados. Si su ingreso o hogar cambio, vuelva a solicitar en tenncare.tn.gov o en su oficina local del Departamento de Servicios Humanos.

name.en: Calculate your 2026 income against ACA Marketplace subsidy thresholds
name.es: Calcule su ingreso de 2026 frente a los umbrales de subsidio del Mercado ACA

text.en: For 2026, ACA Marketplace premium tax credits apply to incomes between 100% and 400% FPL. For a single adult, that is $15,960 to $63,840 per year. For a family of four, that is $33,000 to $132,000. The 400% FPL subsidy cliff returned in 2026 after enhanced premium tax credits from ARPA expired January 1, 2026. If your income falls under 100% FPL (the coverage gap in Tennessee), contact a Tennessee legal aid organization or navigator, as you may still qualify for Medicaid in specific circumstances. Use the ACA income limits calculator at /aca-income-limits to confirm your subsidy eligibility.
text.es: Para 2026, los creditos fiscales de prima del Mercado ACA aplican para ingresos entre el 100% y el 400% FPL. Para un adulto soltero, eso es de $15,960 a $63,840 por ano. Para una familia de cuatro, es de $33,000 a $132,000. El precipicio de subsidios del 400% FPL regreso en 2026 despues de que los creditos fiscales mejorados de ARPA expiraron el 1 de enero de 2026. Si su ingreso cae bajo el 100% FPL, contacte a una organizacion de ayuda legal de Tennessee o un navegador.

name.en: Start your ACA Marketplace SEP application at healthcare.gov
name.es: Inicie su solicitud SEP del Mercado ACA en healthcare.gov

text.en: Log in or create an account at healthcare.gov and select 'I lost qualifying health coverage' as your qualifying life event. Choose Medicaid or CHIP as the type of coverage lost and enter your TennCare termination date. Your 90-day SEP window starts from that date. Compare Silver plans first: Silver plans with cost-sharing reductions are available to people at 138% to 250% FPL and can reduce your deductible to as low as $150 and your out-of-pocket maximum to under $3,000. Tennessee Marketplace plans are all through healthcare.gov, not a state-based exchange.
text.es: Inicie sesion o cree una cuenta en healthcare.gov y seleccione 'Perdi cobertura medica calificada' como su evento calificador de vida. Elija Medicaid o CHIP como el tipo de cobertura perdida e ingrese su fecha de terminacion de TennCare. Su ventana SEP de 90 dias comienza desde esa fecha. Compare primero los planes Silver: los planes Silver con reducciones en la participacion de costos estan disponibles para personas con ingresos entre el 138% y el 250% FPL.

name.en: File a TennCare appeal at the same time as your Marketplace application
name.es: Presente una apelacion de TennCare al mismo tiempo que su solicitud del Mercado

text.en: Submit your TennCare fair hearing request by calling TennCare at 1-800-342-3145 or by submitting a written request to the Tennessee Division of TennCare within 30 days of the notice date. You can request continuation of benefits during the appeal process. File your appeal AND apply for marketplace coverage simultaneously so you are not uninsured if the appeal takes several weeks. If the appeal succeeds, you can cancel the Marketplace plan before it takes effect.
text.es: Presente su solicitud de audiencia justa de TennCare llamando al 1-800-342-3145 o enviando una solicitud escrita a la Division de TennCare de Tennessee dentro de los 30 dias de la fecha del aviso. Puede solicitar continuacion de beneficios durante el proceso de apelacion. Presente su apelacion Y solicite cobertura del Mercado simultaneamente para no quedar sin seguro.

name.en: Apply for TennCare Kids for children in your household year-round
name.es: Solicite TennCare Kids para los ninos de su hogar en cualquier momento del ano

text.en: TennCare Kids covers children under 19 in Tennessee, with income limits that vary by age (up to 195% FPL for infants, 142% FPL ages 1-6, 133% FPL ages 6-19). Even if you as an adult lose TennCare eligibility, your children may still qualify for TennCare Kids. Apply year-round through tenncare.tn.gov or your local Department of Human Services office. Children's enrollment is separate from adult enrollment and has no deadline. Submit your TennCare Kids application with proof of Tennessee residency, birth certificates, and household income documents.
text.es: TennCare Kids cubre a los ninos menores de 19 anos en Tennessee, con limites de ingresos que varian por edad (hasta el 195% FPL para bebes, 142% FPL para ninos de 1 a 6 anos, 133% FPL para ninos de 6 a 19 anos). Aunque usted como adulto pierda elegibilidad para TennCare, sus hijos pueden seguir calificando para TennCare Kids. Solicite en cualquier momento del ano a traves de tenncare.tn.gov o su oficina local del Departamento de Servicios Humanos.

name.en: Submit proof of TennCare loss and enroll before day 90
name.es: Presente prueba de perdida de TennCare e inscribase antes del dia 90

text.en: Upload your TennCare termination letter to healthcare.gov within 30 days of selecting a Marketplace plan. Coverage typically begins the first of the month after you enroll and pay your first premium. Do not let the 90-day window lapse. If you miss the SEP and a new qualifying life event occurs (job change, marriage, birth, move to another state), you get a new 60-day or 90-day SEP. The next ACA Open Enrollment Period for 2027 coverage opens November 1, 2026.
text.es: Suba su carta de terminacion de TennCare a healthcare.gov dentro de los 30 dias posteriores a seleccionar un plan del Mercado. La cobertura generalmente comienza el primer dia del mes despues de que se inscriba y pague su primera prima. No deje que la ventana de 90 dias expire. Si pierde el SEP, la siguiente Inscripcion Abierta del ACA para cobertura 2027 comienza el 1 de noviembre de 2026.

People with income under 100% FPL who do not qualify for TennCare may face a coverage gap; contact Tennessee Justice Center or Legal Aid Society of Middle Tennessee for assistance.
footnote.es: Tennessee es un estado sin expansion: los adultos sin hijos ni discapacidad generalmente no califican para TennCare independientemente de sus ingresos. El precipicio de subsidios ACA del 400% FPL regreso en 2026. Las personas con ingresos bajo el 100% FPL que no califican para TennCare pueden enfrentar una brecha de cobertura.

intro.en: The most costly mistakes Tennessee residents make after losing TennCare in 2026:
intro.es: Los errores mas costosos que los residentes de Tennessee cometen despues de perder TennCare en 2026:

items.en: Assuming the Marketplace 60-day SEP applies. Loss of Medicaid or CHIP (including TennCare) gives you 90 days to enroll in a Marketplace plan at healthcare.gov, not the standard 60 days that applies to most other qualifying life events.
items.es: Asumir que el SEP de 60 dias del Mercado aplica. La perdida de Medicaid o CHIP (incluido TennCare) le da 90 dias para inscribirse en un plan del Mercado en healthcare.gov, no los 60 dias estandar que aplican a la mayoria de los otros eventos calificados.

items.en: Not filing an appeal. TennCare terminations based on data-match errors or documents that were submitted but not logged are common in 2026 with stricter OBBBA verification rules. Always appeal within 30 days if the reason seems wrong or based on outdated information.
items.es: No presentar una apelacion. Las terminaciones de TennCare basadas en errores de datos o documentos enviados pero no registrados son comunes en 2026 con las reglas de verificacion mas estrictas de la OBBBA. Siempre apele dentro de los 30 dias si la razon parece incorrecta o se basa en informacion desactualizada.

items.en: Waiting for the appeal to resolve before applying for Marketplace coverage. Appeals take weeks or months. Apply for a Marketplace SEP the same day you file the appeal. If the appeal succeeds, you can cancel the Marketplace plan.
items.es: Esperar a que se resuelva la apelacion antes de solicitar cobertura del Mercado. Las apelaciones tardan semanas o meses. Solicite un SEP del Mercado el mismo dia que presente la apelacion. Si la apelacion tiene exito, puede cancelar el plan del Mercado.

items.en: Thinking children lose TennCare automatically when adults do. TennCare Kids eligibility is evaluated separately, with income limits that vary by child's age, and many children qualify even when adults in the same household lose TennCare. Apply for children through tenncare.tn.gov regardless of adult eligibility.
items.es: Pensar que los ninos pierden TennCare automaticamente cuando los adultos lo pierden. La elegibilidad de TennCare Kids se evalua por separado, con limites de ingresos que varian segun la edad del nino, y muchos ninos califican incluso cuando los adultos del mismo hogar pierden TennCare. Solicite para los ninos a traves de tenncare.tn.gov independientemente de la elegibilidad del adulto.

items.en: Enrolling in a short-term health plan to fill the gap. Short-term plans sold in Tennessee are not ACA-compliant, typically exclude pre-existing conditions, and do not count as creditable coverage. An ACA Marketplace Silver plan with subsidies is almost always a better option for people with income between 100% and 400% FPL.
items.es: Inscribirse en un plan de salud a corto plazo para llenar la brecha. Los planes a corto plazo vendidos en Tennessee no cumplen con el ACA, generalmente excluyen condiciones preexistentes y no cuentan como cobertura acreditable. Un plan Silver del Mercado ACA con subsidios es casi siempre una mejor opcion para personas con ingresos entre el 100% y el 400% FPL.

items.en: Not using a free navigator. Tennessee has federally certified Marketplace navigators who can walk you through the healthcare.gov application at no cost, help calculate your projected 2026 income for subsidy purposes, and assist with TennCare appeals. Contact Tennessee Primary Care Association at (615) 726-3688 or find your local navigator at localhelp.healthcare.gov.
items.es: No usar un navegador gratuito. Tennessee tiene navegadores del Mercado certificados federalmente que pueden guiarlo a traves de la solicitud de healthcare.gov sin costo, ayudar a calcular su ingreso proyectado de 2026 y ayudar con las apelaciones de TennCare. Contacte a la Asociacion de Atencion Primaria de Tennessee al (615) 726-3688 o encuentre su navegador local en localhelp.healthcare.gov.

heading.en: Tennessee Non-Expansion: Why Losing TennCare Is Different from Other States
heading.es: No Expansion de Tennessee: Por Que Perder TennCare Es Diferente a Otros Estados

paragraphs.en: Tennessee is one of 10 states that has not expanded Medicaid under the ACA as of 2026. That policy choice has two major consequences for people who lose TennCare. First, most working-age adults without dependent children cannot qualify for TennCare at all, regardless of income, so re-enrollment is not an option for them. Second, adults under 100% FPL in Tennessee who do not meet TennCare's categorical requirements fall into a coverage gap: they earn too little for ACA Marketplace subsidies (which start at 100% FPL) and too much, or wrong category, for TennCare. The 10 non-expansion states are Alabama, Florida, Georgia, Kansas, Mississippi, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Wisconsin, and Wyoming. In expansion states, Medicaid covers adults up to 138% FPL at $22,025 for a single person in 2026. TennCare's limits for parents are approximately 100% FPL, about $21,640 for a household of two in 2026. This gap affects approximately 140,000 Tennesseans according to KFF 2026 estimates, and losing TennCare can land a low-income adult directly in it.
paragraphs.es: Tennessee es uno de los 10 estados que no ha expandido Medicaid bajo el ACA a partir de 2026. Esa decision politica tiene dos consecuencias principales para las personas que pierden TennCare. Primero, la mayoria de los adultos en edad de trabajar sin hijos dependientes no pueden calificar para TennCare en absoluto, independientemente de sus ingresos. Segundo, los adultos bajo el 100% FPL en Tennessee que no cumplen los requisitos categoricos de TennCare caen en una brecha de cobertura: ganan demasiado poco para los subsidios del Mercado ACA y demasiado, o estan en la categoria incorrecta, para TennCare. Esta brecha afecta a aproximadamente 140,000 residentes de Tennessee segun estimaciones de KFF de 2026.

paragraphs.en: Tennesseans who do qualify for TennCare re-enrollment can apply year-round through tenncare.tn.gov or their local Department of Human Services office. Categories with the most room for re-qualification after a termination include pregnant women (up to 195% FPL, and coverage continues through 12 months postpartum under federal rules), children under 19 through TennCare Kids (up to 250% FPL), disabled adults meeting SSI criteria, and parents with minor children in households under 95% FPL. For everyone else, the ACA Marketplace is the primary path. The 2026 ACA Marketplace OEP for 2027 coverage runs November 1, 2026 through January 15, 2027, making the 90-day SEP after TennCare loss the only available enrollment window for most people losing coverage mid-year.
paragraphs.es: Los residentes de Tennessee que califican para la reinscripcion en TennCare pueden solicitar en cualquier momento del ano a traves de tenncare.tn.gov o su oficina local del Departamento de Servicios Humanos. Las categorias con mas posibilidades de recalificacion incluyen mujeres embarazadas (hasta el 195% FPL, y la cobertura continua durante 12 meses posparto), ninos menores de 19 anos a traves de TennCare Kids (hasta el 250% FPL), adultos discapacitados que cumplen los criterios de SSI, y padres con hijos menores en hogares bajo el 95% FPL.

heading.en: TennCare Income Limits and Eligibility Categories for 2026
heading.es: Limites de Ingresos y Categorias de Elegibilidad de TennCare para 2026

paragraphs.en: TennCare uses Modified Adjusted Gross Income (MAGI) for most eligibility determinations in 2026. Tennessee's eligibility rules create four distinct groups. Parents and caretaker relatives with dependent children qualify up to approximately 100% of the Federal Poverty Level, which is about $21,640 per year for a household of two in 2026. Pregnant women qualify up to 250% FPL, approximately $54,100 for a household of two, and coverage continues through 12 months postpartum under the American Rescue Plan Act provision now made permanent. Children under 19 qualify through TennCare Kids, with income limits that vary by age. Adults on SSI or receiving Social Security Disability Insurance who qualify for Medicare may receive both Medicare and TennCare as dual-eligible beneficiaries. Non-disabled adults without dependent children do not qualify for TennCare under any income level, unlike Medicaid expansion states where adults qualify up to 138% FPL.
paragraphs.es: TennCare usa el Ingreso Bruto Ajustado Modificado (MAGI) para la mayoria de las determinaciones de elegibilidad en 2026. Las reglas de elegibilidad de Tennessee crean cuatro grupos distintos. Los padres y cuidadores con hijos dependientes califican hasta aproximadamente el 100% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza, aproximadamente $21,640 al ano para un hogar de dos en 2026. Las mujeres embarazadas califican hasta el 250% FPL, aproximadamente $54,100 para un hogar de dos, y la cobertura continua durante 12 meses posparto. Los ninos menores de 19 anos califican a traves de TennCare Kids, con limites de ingresos que varian por edad. Los adultos no discapacitados sin hijos dependientes no califican para TennCare bajo ningun nivel de ingresos.

heading.en: ACA Marketplace Coverage After Losing TennCare in Tennessee 2026
heading.es: Cobertura del Mercado ACA Despues de Perder TennCare en Tennessee 2026

paragraphs.en: Losing TennCare qualifies as a qualifying life event that triggers a 90-day Special Enrollment Period for ACA Marketplace plans at healthcare.gov. Tennessee uses the federal Marketplace, not a state-based exchange, so all TennCare-to-Marketplace transitions go through healthcare.gov. The 2026 subsidy structure matters significantly for people who lose TennCare: enhanced premium tax credits from the American Rescue Plan Act expired January 1, 2026, returning the 400% FPL subsidy cliff. People with incomes between 100% and 400% FPL ($15,960 to $63,840 single person in 2026) still qualify for standard ACA premium tax credits under the Affordable Care Act. People above 400% FPL receive no subsidy in 2026 and pay full premium, which averages $500 to $800 per month for a 40-year-old in Tennessee.
paragraphs.es: Perder TennCare califica como un evento calificador de vida que activa un Periodo de Inscripcion Especial de 90 dias para los planes del Mercado ACA en healthcare.gov. Tennessee usa el Mercado federal, no un intercambio estatal. La estructura de subsidios de 2026 importa significativamente para las personas que pierden TennCare: los creditos fiscales de prima mejorados de ARPA expiraron el 1 de enero de 2026, devolviendo el precipicio de subsidios del 400% FPL. Las personas con ingresos entre el 100% y el 400% FPL aun califican para los creditos fiscales de prima estandar del ACA.

paragraphs.en: Silver plans on the Tennessee Marketplace deserve special attention for people transitioning from TennCare in 2026. Tennesseans with incomes between 100% and 250% FPL (up to approximately $39,900 single, $82,500 family of four in 2026) qualify for cost-sharing reductions on Silver plans, which can dramatically reduce the deductible from the standard $3,000 to as low as $150, and reduce the out-of-pocket maximum from $10,600 to under $3,000. The 1095-A tax form, which Marketplace enrollees receive each January, is used to reconcile premium tax credits on your federal tax return. Enroll at healthcare.gov during your 90-day SEP, select your plan, pay your first premium, and upload your TennCare termination letter as proof of the qualifying event.
paragraphs.es: Los planes Silver en el Mercado de Tennessee merecen atencion especial para las personas que hacen la transicion desde TennCare en 2026. Los residentes de Tennessee con ingresos entre el 100% y el 250% FPL califican para reducciones en la participacion de costos en los planes Silver, lo que puede reducir dramaticamente el deducible de $3,000 estandar a tan solo $150. El formulario 1095-A, que los inscritos en el Mercado reciben cada enero, se usa para conciliar los creditos fiscales de prima en su declaracion de impuestos federal.

heading.en: Documents Needed to Enroll in the Marketplace After Losing TennCare
heading.es: Documentos Necesarios para Inscribirse en el Mercado Despues de Perder TennCare

paragraphs.en: Three sets of documents drive the TennCare-to-Marketplace application. First, your TennCare termination letter: this is your proof of the qualifying life event (loss of coverage) that opens the 90-day SEP window. Upload it to healthcare.gov within 30 days of selecting a plan. Second, proof of 2026 income: healthcare.gov uses projected annual Modified Adjusted Gross Income for the current year, not last year's income. Recent pay stubs, an employer letter, or a self-employed income estimate covering the rest of 2026 work well. Third, Social Security numbers for everyone applying. TennCare loss-to-Marketplace transitions do not require Section 9831 HIPAA creditable coverage certificates because Medicaid loss itself is the qualifying event under 45 CFR 155.420. Current Tennessee address and ZIP code are required because plan availability and premiums differ by county.
paragraphs.es: Tres conjuntos de documentos impulsan la solicitud de TennCare al Mercado. Primero, su carta de terminacion de TennCare: esta es su prueba del evento calificador de vida (perdida de cobertura) que abre la ventana SEP de 90 dias. Subala a healthcare.gov dentro de los 30 dias de seleccionar un plan. Segundo, prueba de ingresos de 2026: healthcare.gov usa el Ingreso Bruto Ajustado Modificado anual proyectado para el ano actual. Tercero, numeros de Seguro Social para todos los que solicitan.

en: TennCare termination letter or written notice (required proof of qualifying life event for the 90-day SEP at healthcare.gov)
Social Security numbers for all household members applying for coverage
Proof of 2026 projected household income: recent pay stubs, employer letter, or self-employment income estimate for the remainder of 2026
Current Tennessee mailing address and ZIP code (plan availability and premiums differ by county)
Birth certificates for children if applying for TennCare Kids separately
Proof of Tennessee residency (utility bill, lease agreement, or driver's license)
Immigration documents if applicable (lawfully present immigrants may qualify for Marketplace coverage)
Bank account information for premium autopay if you choose that option after enrollment
es: Carta de terminacion de TennCare o aviso escrito (prueba requerida del evento calificador de vida para el SEP de 90 dias en healthcare.gov)
Numeros de Seguro Social para todos los miembros del hogar que solicitan cobertura
Prueba de ingreso del hogar proyectado para 2026: talones de pago recientes, carta del empleador, o estimacion de ingresos por cuenta propia para el resto de 2026
Direccion postal actual en Tennessee y codigo postal (la disponibilidad de planes y las primas difieren por condado)
Actas de nacimiento para ninos si solicita TennCare Kids por separado
Prueba de residencia en Tennessee (factura de servicios, contrato de arrendamiento o licencia de conducir)
Documentos de inmigracion si corresponde (los inmigrantes legalmente presentes pueden calificar para cobertura del Mercado)
Informacion de cuenta bancaria para debito automatico de prima si elige esa opcion despues de la inscripcion

en: Missing the 90-day SEP window: application submitted after Day 90 from TennCare termination date, forcing a wait until the November Open Enrollment Period
Insufficient documentation: no TennCare termination letter uploaded to healthcare.gov within 30 days of plan selection
Reporting last year's income instead of projected 2026 income: ACA subsidies are based on what you expect to earn for the remainder of 2026, not your prior-year tax return
Applying for TennCare as a non-disabled adult without dependent children: Tennessee categorically excludes this group regardless of income

Confusing TennCare Kids and adult TennCare applications: children's and adult TennCare eligibility are evaluated under different income rules and must be handled through the correct application pathway
es: Perder la ventana SEP de 90 dias: solicitud presentada despues del dia 90 desde la fecha de terminacion de TennCare, forzando una espera hasta el Periodo de Inscripcion Abierta de noviembre
Documentacion insuficiente: no se subio la carta de terminacion de TennCare a healthcare.gov dentro de los 30 dias de la seleccion del plan

Reportar los ingresos del ano pasado en lugar de los ingresos proyectados para 2026: los subsidios del ACA se basan en lo que espera ganar por el resto de 2026, no en su declaracion de impuestos del ano anterior
Solicitar TennCare como adulto no discapacitado sin hijos dependientes: Tennessee excluye categoricamente a este grupo independientemente de los ingresos

Confundir las solicitudes de TennCare Kids y TennCare para adultos: la elegibilidad de TennCare para ninos y adultos se evalua bajo diferentes reglas de ingresos y debe manejarse a traves de la via de solicitud correcta

en.question: How long do I have to enroll in an ACA Marketplace plan after losing TennCare?
en.answer: You have 90 days from the date your TennCare coverage ended to enroll in an ACA Marketplace plan through the Loss of Minimum Essential Coverage Special Enrollment Period. This is longer than the standard 60-day SEP that applies to most other qualifying life events. Log in to healthcare.gov, select 'I lost qualifying health coverage,' choose Medicaid or CHIP as the type of coverage lost, and enter your TennCare termination date. Your 90-day clock starts from that termination date, not from when you received the notice.

en.question: Why is TennCare in Tennessee different from Medicaid in other states?
en.answer: Tennessee is one of 10 states that has not expanded Medicaid under the ACA as of 2026. In 40 expansion states plus DC, adults qualify for Medicaid up to 138% FPL, which is $22,025 for a single person in 2026. TennCare covers a much narrower group: parents and caretakers up to approximately 100% FPL, pregnant women up to 250% FPL, children under 19 through TennCare Kids with age-tiered income limits, and disabled adults. Non-disabled adults without children do not qualify for TennCare at any income level. This means losing TennCare in Tennessee carries different risks than losing Medicaid in an expansion state.

en.question: Can I re-qualify for TennCare after losing it?
en.answer: Possibly, depending on your category. Parents with dependent children can re-apply year-round if their income is at or below approximately 100% FPL ($21,640 for a household of two in 2026). Pregnant women can re-apply up to 250% FPL. Children under 19 can re-apply for TennCare Kids at any time, with income limits that vary by age. Non-disabled adults without dependent children are categorically excluded from TennCare. Apply through tenncare.tn.gov or your local Department of Human Services office. If your termination was based on a paperwork error or outdated income information, file an appeal within 30 days of the notice date.

en.question: What if my income is under 100% FPL and I cannot re-qualify for TennCare?
en.answer: Tennessee adults with income under 100% FPL who do not meet TennCare categorical requirements fall into the Medicaid coverage gap. ACA Marketplace subsidies start at 100% FPL, so these individuals are not eligible for subsidized Marketplace coverage either. Options include: emergency Medicaid for qualifying medical emergencies, community health centers that provide sliding-scale care regardless of insurance (find locations at findahealthcenter.hrsa.gov), and assistance from legal aid organizations like the Tennessee Justice Center at (615) 255-0331 who may help identify overlooked eligibility.

en.question: What is the TennCare appeal process and how long do I have?
en.answer: Tennessee allows 30 days from the date of the termination notice to request a TennCare fair hearing. Call TennCare Member Services at 1-800-342-3145 or submit a written request to the Tennessee Division of TennCare. If you request the hearing before your coverage end date, you may receive continuation of benefits during the appeal process. Appeals based on procedural errors (state did not process documents you submitted on time) or disputed income calculations have the best success rates. A free legal aid attorney from Tennessee Justice Center or Legal Aid Society of Middle Tennessee can help with the appeal at no cost.

en.question: Do my children lose TennCare if I do?
en.answer: Not necessarily. TennCare Kids eligibility for children under 19 is evaluated separately from adult TennCare eligibility and uses age-tiered income limits (195% FPL for infants under 1, 142% FPL for ages 1-6, 133% FPL for ages 6-19 per tenncare.tn.gov). Even if you as an adult no longer qualify for TennCare, your children may still be eligible. Apply for TennCare Kids through tenncare.tn.gov or your local Department of Human Services office year-round. Enrollment is not tied to the adult enrollment timeline and has no deadline.

en.question: Does the 2026 ACA subsidy cliff affect me if I am switching from TennCare to the Marketplace?
en.answer: Yes, if your income is above 400% FPL ($63,840 for a single person, $132,000 for a family of four in 2026). The enhanced premium tax credits from the American Rescue Plan Act expired January 1, 2026, so people above 400% FPL receive no ACA premium tax credit and pay full premium, typically $500 to $900 per month for a 40-year-old in Tennessee. If your income is between 100% and 400% FPL, standard ACA premium tax credits still apply and Silver plans remain affordable, especially with cost-sharing reductions for incomes under 250% FPL.

en.question: What documents do I need to prove I lost TennCare when applying at healthcare.gov?
en.answer: Your TennCare termination letter or written notice from the Tennessee Division of TennCare is the primary proof of qualifying life event. Upload it to healthcare.gov within 30 days of selecting a plan. You will also need Social Security numbers for all applicants, your current Tennessee ZIP code, and proof of projected 2026 household income (recent pay stubs or a letter from your employer). For TennCare Kids applications, birth certificates for children are required. Free navigator assistance is available at localhelp.healthcare.gov if you need help assembling documents.

es.question: Cuanto tiempo tengo para inscribirme en un plan del Mercado ACA despues de perder TennCare?
es.answer: Tiene 90 dias desde la fecha en que termino su cobertura de TennCare para inscribirse en un plan del Mercado ACA a traves del Periodo de Inscripcion Especial por Perdida de Cobertura Minima Esencial. Esto es mas largo que el SEP estandar de 60 dias que aplica a la mayoria de los otros eventos calificadores de vida. Inicie sesion en healthcare.gov, seleccione 'Perdi cobertura medica calificada', elija Medicaid o CHIP como el tipo de cobertura perdida e ingrese su fecha de terminacion de TennCare. Su reloj de 90 dias comienza desde esa fecha de terminacion, no desde cuando recibio el aviso.

es.question: Por que TennCare en Tennessee es diferente de Medicaid en otros estados?
es.answer: Tennessee es uno de los 10 estados que no ha expandido Medicaid bajo el ACA a partir de 2026. En los 40 estados con expansion mas DC, los adultos califican para Medicaid hasta el 138% FPL, que es $22,025 para una persona sola en 2026. TennCare cubre un grupo mucho mas reducido: padres y cuidadores hasta aproximadamente el 100% FPL, mujeres embarazadas hasta el 250% FPL, ninos menores de 19 anos a traves de TennCare Kids con limites por edad, y adultos discapacitados. Los adultos no discapacitados sin hijos no califican para TennCare en ningun nivel de ingresos.

es.question: Puedo recalificar para TennCare despues de perderlo?
es.answer: Posiblemente, dependiendo de su categoria. Los padres con hijos dependientes pueden volver a solicitar en cualquier momento si sus ingresos estan al nivel del 100% FPL o menos (aproximadamente $21,640 para un hogar de dos en 2026). Las mujeres embarazadas pueden volver a solicitar hasta el 250% FPL. Los ninos menores de 19 anos pueden volver a solicitar TennCare Kids en cualquier momento, con limites de ingresos que varian por edad. Los adultos no discapacitados sin hijos dependientes estan categoricamente excluidos de TennCare. Solicite a traves de tenncare.tn.gov o su oficina local del Departamento de Servicios Humanos.

es.question: Que pasa si mis ingresos estan bajo el 100% FPL y no puedo recalificar para TennCare?
es.answer: Los adultos de Tennessee con ingresos bajo el 100% FPL que no cumplen los requisitos categoricos de TennCare caen en la brecha de cobertura de Medicaid. Los subsidios del Mercado ACA comienzan al 100% FPL, por lo que estas personas tampoco son elegibles para cobertura subsidiada. Las opciones incluyen: Medicaid de emergencia para emergencias medicas que califiquen, centros comunitarios de salud con atencion a escala reducida independientemente del seguro (encuentre ubicaciones en findahealthcenter.hrsa.gov), y asistencia de organizaciones de ayuda legal como el Tennessee Justice Center al (615) 255-0331.

es.question: Cual es el proceso de apelacion de TennCare y cuanto tiempo tengo?
es.answer: Tennessee permite 30 dias desde la fecha del aviso de terminacion para solicitar una audiencia justa de TennCare. Llame a los Servicios para Miembros de TennCare al 1-800-342-3145 o presente una solicitud escrita a la Division de TennCare de Tennessee. Si solicita la audiencia antes de la fecha de fin de su cobertura, puede recibir continuacion de beneficios durante el proceso de apelacion. Un abogado gratuito del Tennessee Justice Center puede ayudar con la apelacion sin costo.

es.question: Mis hijos pierden TennCare si yo lo pierdo?
es.answer: No necesariamente. La elegibilidad de TennCare Kids para ninos menores de 19 anos se evalua por separado de la elegibilidad de TennCare para adultos y usa limites de ingresos por edad (195% FPL para bebes menores de 1 ano, 142% FPL para ninos de 1 a 6 anos, 133% FPL para ninos de 6 a 19 anos segun tenncare.tn.gov). Aunque usted como adulto ya no califique para TennCare, sus hijos pueden seguir siendo elegibles. Solicite TennCare Kids a traves de tenncare.tn.gov o su oficina local del Departamento de Servicios Humanos en cualquier momento del ano.

es.question: El precipicio de subsidios ACA 2026 me afecta si cambio de TennCare al Mercado?
es.answer: Si, si su ingreso esta por encima del 400% FPL ($63,840 para una persona sola, $132,000 para una familia de cuatro en 2026). Los creditos fiscales de prima mejorados de ARPA expiraron el 1 de enero de 2026, por lo que las personas por encima del 400% FPL no reciben credito fiscal de prima del ACA y pagan la prima completa. Si su ingreso esta entre el 100% y el 400% FPL, los creditos fiscales estandar del ACA aun aplican y los planes Silver siguen siendo asequibles.

es.question: Que documentos necesito para probar que perdi TennCare al solicitar en healthcare.gov?
es.answer: Su carta de terminacion de TennCare o aviso escrito de la Division de TennCare de Tennessee es la prueba principal del evento calificador de vida. Subala a healthcare.gov dentro de los 30 dias de seleccionar un plan. Tambien necesitara numeros de Seguro Social para todos los solicitantes, su codigo postal actual en Tennessee y prueba de ingreso del hogar proyectado para 2026. Para solicitudes de TennCare Kids, se requieren actas de nacimiento para los ninos. La asistencia gratuita de navegadores esta disponible en localhelp.healthcare.gov.
